name: 门户网站
description: Public website surface: homepage sections, articles and the contact form. Owns three legacy-named tables and reads nothing else. Declares no dependsOn because it never touches students or classes.

data._adopted_note: All three keep their legacy names: `SELECT *` rows from articles are returned to the frontend as-is, so column names (cover_image, is_published, view_count) are the JSON contract.
data._auth_note: The four editor routes (PUT /home, POST|PUT|DELETE /articles*) now require an admin/superadmin actor: 401 for anonymous (未登录或登录已过期), 403 for any other role (无权限执行该操作); the admin console is their only caller, and before this batch an unnamed visitor could rewrite the homepage, publish articles or delete every article. The four public routes (GET /home, GET /articles, GET /articles/:id, POST /contact) stay anonymous on purpose - the marketing site and the contact form are reached before login - and their route declarations above say public for that reason.
